projects.title: Hybrid Glaucoma Screening
projects.summary: Two kinds of retinal evidence. One more considered decision.
projects.description: A hybrid screening approach that combines visual and structural retinal evidence, with a conformal safety net for uncertain cases.
projects.overview: I led a four-person team combining image-based and structural retinal features for glaucoma screening. Rather than forcing a prediction in every case, the system routes uncertain results for manual review.
projects.approach: Training used 7,618 retinal images. Evaluation on a separate 1,353-image test set reported a rise from 82.71% to 87.21% accuracy, with 89.57% sensitivity and 85.80% specificity. The uncertainty safeguard referred 26 cases (1.92%) for manual review.
projects.note: Academic project results from the supplied résumé; these are evaluation results, not a clinical validation claim.

projects.title: AI Interview Platform
projects.summary: Six services. A connected interview experience.
projects.description: Interview orchestration, code execution and real-time computer-vision proctoring, built as a six-service system.
projects.overview: An individual full-stack project bringing interview workflows, live proctoring, evaluation and code execution together through a service-based architecture.
projects.approach: The platform separates authentication, interview orchestration, proctoring, evaluation, code execution and notifications. Computer-vision components use YOLO and MediaPipe; PostgreSQL and Redis support the application data and service workflows.
projects.note: The diagram summarises the service responsibilities described in my résumé; it is not a deployment topology.

projects.title: Underwater Image Enhancement
projects.summary: Learning to see beneath the surface.
projects.description: A physics-informed DQN learns a sequence of image corrections to recover visibility and colour.
projects.overview: A team project exploring how reinforcement learning can select image corrections rather than relying on one fixed enhancement pipeline.
projects.approach: A 10-dimensional visual state informs a Deep Q-Network. Available corrections include white balance, CLAHE, gamma correction, denoising, dehazing and colour compensation. On 649 test images, UIQM improved from 46.43 to 66.55 (+43.3%), and UCIQE from 24.36 to 29.70 (+21.9%).
projects.note: Reported image-quality metrics are from the supplied résumé and apply to the evaluated test set.

projects.title: AarogyaLink
projects.description: An ideathon concept for secure healthcare records, verified access and offline-first synchronisation.
projects.overview: I led the AarogyaLink presentation at the MITE First Ideathon, exploring a connected approach to healthcare records and role-aware access.
projects.approach: The concept brings together verified roles, encrypted sharing, emergency access and offline-first synchronisation. Flutter, Node.js and PostgreSQL form the proposed technology direction recorded in the existing portfolio.
projects.note: Presented as an ideathon concept. The listed capabilities describe the proposal, not a deployed healthcare service.

projects.title: LabCode
projects.summary: From a submission to a meaningful result.
projects.description: Backend workflows for programming problems, submissions, evaluations and marks across academic domains.
projects.overview: An ongoing three-person project supporting programming practice and evaluation through structured academic workflows.
projects.approach: My work covers problem and submission management, DTO validation, evaluation and marks, academic domain modelling, and unit and integration testing. The focus is a backend that is understandable and reliable as the workflows grow.
projects.note: Ongoing work. No production adoption or completion figures are claimed.

about.title: Curiosity is the common thread.
about.intro: I build where ideas meet engineering.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer and AI/ML builder working across backend architecture, distributed systems, product interfaces and computer vision.
I like understanding the problem deeply, then finding a clear, dependable way forward. Outside the code, I explore that same process through a camera, a performance or an edit.
Through Captcha and Pixel, I contribute across the production process—from performance and the shoot to behind-the-scenes capture and the edit.
